    structure LargeIndecomposable.ClosedZigzagTransfer.ClosedZigzagSpanCoefficientData {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type x} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u, x} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (D : CategoryTheory.Functor (LinearPathCategory.Category k (ClosedZigzag.Vertex n)ᵒᵖ) C) [D.Additive] [CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear k D] :
    Type u

    The closed-zigzag coefficient boundary with every zero equation replaced by its source-theoretic strict principal-span statement. Coefficients are required to kill the endpoint-Jacobson layer of their own landing path. Thus the only non-formal cross datum is that each forbidden cross composite lies strictly below the stable landing generator in the principal bimodule chain.
